# Joseph Davis Chamdani

> Personal portfolio of Joseph Davis Chamdani, an Informatics student at the University of Washington (Class of 2027) based in Seattle. He builds AI and data products: 1st place at the UW Claude Hackathon, a merged open-source contribution to NVIDIA's garak AI red-teaming toolkit, and AI/ML internships at Whitespace Solutions, Sector (cybersecurity), and Stockbit. The site also hosts "Ask Joseph," an AI assistant grounded in his real work that can answer questions and surface his projects, photos, and documents.

## Identity

This site represents Joseph Davis Chamdani, the University of Washington Informatics student and software and AI builder whose primary website is https://joechamdani.com/. Other people share the name Joseph Chamdani; this profile refers only to him. Consistent handles: JosephDavisC on GitHub and YouTube, joseph-chamdani on LinkedIn.

## Ask Joseph (AI assistant)

- The portfolio embeds a chat assistant grounded only in Joseph's verified work. It answers questions about his projects, experience, and skills, shows supporting media and links, and declines anything it cannot support. Best first stop for an agent evaluating his fit.

## Featured projects

- [Joe Builds Things](https://www.instagram.com/joebuildthings/): Joseph's personal side project, a short comedy series about a college student and his overly helpful AI sidekick, made with a code pipeline he built. A script written as JSON renders into a finished vertical 3D short: voxel characters, set, cameras and animated captions in Remotion and React Three Fiber (three.js), both voices cloned locally with open source Chatterbox TTS, Whisper transcription plus a pitch check that rejects off takes before render, and sound effects generated in Python (numpy). Season 1 started October 20, 2026. Every episode, newest first: https://joechamdani.com/projects/joe-builds-things/
  Ep 4 "Order For Me" (Oct 25, 2026): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JAs4CBSM268
  Ep 5 "One Message Left" (Oct 28, 2026): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/QDRURlEQQuI
  Ep 3 "Let Me Fix That" (Oct 23, 2026): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kpZunpCussQ
  Ep 2 "Rotate Every Key" (Oct 21, 2026): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nNa5JfGEd3s
  Ep 1 "I Said Staging" (Oct 20, 2026): https://www.youtube.com/shorts/s5g0TvcpCQI
  Also on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@JosephDavisC and TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@josephdavisc
- [Personal Dashboard](https://github.com/JosephDavisC/Personal-Dashboard): open source, self-hosted dashboard for his daily life (calendar, tasks, work shifts with automatic pay, job applications, diary, and an AI chat built on Claude with tools over the data). Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker. Built in 15 days in February 2026 and used daily since. Live demo: https://dashboard-demo.joechamdani.com. Write-up: https://joechamdani.com/blog/personal-dashboard/
- [Freelance Client Portal](https://freelance.joechamdani.com): two-sided portal for Joseph's freelance practice; clients track live milestones, activity, and payments, an admin control room manages projects and site content with no redeploy (React, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind). Live demo: https://freelance.joechamdani.com/dashboard?demo=1
- [Dragon Dance Collectibles](https://dragondance.id): bilingual English/Indonesian catalog site for a Jakarta Pokemon TCG and collectibles store, WhatsApp ordering, self-serve admin panel; delivered end to end as a paid client project (React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind v4). Case study: https://freelance.joechamdani.com/work/dragondance/
- [AI Transfer Evaluation Tool](https://transfer.joechamdani.cloud): 1st place, UW Claude Hackathon 2025. Parses WA community college transcripts and maps courses to UW equivalents with Claude Vision. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Claude API.
  Case study: https://joechamdani.com/projects/transfer-tool/ (the problem, who it is for, how it compares with the UW Equivalency Guide, Transferology and advisors, and how the product works).
- [IShowStream](https://github.com/JosephDavisC/IShowStream): Real-time Twitch chat analytics using a 5-agent system on Google Gemini, deployed on Cloud Run (Go, Python FastAPI, React). Built by Joseph with teammates; the Medium feature about it was written by a teammate, not by Joseph.
- [garak (NVIDIA)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak/pull/1367): Merged open-source contribution to NVIDIA's garak LLM red-teaming toolkit (CLI filtering, test coverage).
- [ASR-Runner](https://github.com/JosephDavisC/ASR-Runner): Go tool automating attack-surface reconnaissance (subfinder, httpx, katana).
- [JAM.AI](https://github.com/JosephDavisC/Jam.AI): Hackathon prototype from UWB Hacks AI 2024, built with a team of three. Fine-tuned GPT-3.5 on a 600 pair Q&A set with a Flask backend.

## Experience

- [All experience](https://joechamdani.com/experience/): Full timeline of every internship, club, and job.
- [Whitespace Solutions, AI Product Intern](https://joechamdani.com/experience/whitespace): Jul 2026 to Sep 2026, Jakarta, hybrid. Shipped features end to end on a live AI sales-training platform across the database, the backend API and the React front end. Built semantic search for the product's knowledge library on its shared embedding and vector layer, with hybrid ranking, a relevance floor and an AI-label check. Fixed a vector-store bug that silently lost writes and a failure that made chat answer 'no knowledge' on a full library. Also drove competitive analysis of 4 US and APAC sales-enablement platforms that repositioned the product, ran pre-launch QA (30+ defects triaged), and gave live demos to shareholders and enterprise prospects.
- [Information Consulting Group, Technology Operations Associate](https://joechamdani.com/experience/icg): Technology operations and consulting initiatives at a University of Washington student consulting group (current).
- [Software Engineering Career Club at UW (SWECC), Technical Officer](https://swecc.org/): May 2026 to present, Seattle. Helps run the club's career events and keeps its website updated, is helping organize the spring 2027 mentorship cohort, and is a member of SWECC Labs, the club's project team.
- [Sector, AI Research and Development](https://joechamdani.com/experience/sector): AI automation for penetration testing and threat detection; authored three published research papers.
- [Stockbit/Bibit, AI Engineer](https://joechamdani.com/experience/stockbit): OCR/KYC pipeline and fraud detection with Google Cloud AutoML.
- [Touchten Games, Cutscene Guest Student](https://joechamdani.com/experience/touchten): Unity/C# cutscenes.
- [VR Park, Game Developer](https://joechamdani.com/experience/vr-park): Multiplayer VR games in Unity.
- [StarCamp Asia, Game Developer and Experience Center Operator](https://joechamdani.com/experience/vr-park): Multiplayer VR development and metaverse demos in Jakarta and Bali, 2022 to 2023.
- BC Tech Club, President (2024–2025): Led the club and organized [BC Hacks 2024](https://joechamdani.com/blog/bc-hacks-2024).

## Writing

- [All articles](https://joechamdani.com/blog/): The blog index, with an RSS feed at https://joechamdani.com/rss.xml.

Published by Joseph on joechamdani.com:

- [One Screen for My Daily Life, Now Open Source](https://joechamdani.com/blog/personal-dashboard): Blog post about his open source Personal Dashboard (github.com/JosephDavisC/Personal-Dashboard), a self-hosted Next.js app for calendar, tasks, work shifts with automatic pay, job applications, a diary and an AI chat with tools, installed on his phone as a PWA. 259 of its 272 commits landed in 15 days in February 2026, live on his VPS on day 3, used daily since. Covers the build, what he actually uses (shifts every day), iOS push without an Apple developer account, and how he open sourced it safely: a new repo with fresh history, a personal data audit, config templates, a one command demo mode, and secret scanning before every push.
- [The Day My SSL Auto-Renewal Quietly Died](https://joechamdani.com/blog/ssl-renewal-quietly-died): Infrastructure debugging story. Three of his nine sites came within days of expired certificates while the rest renewed normally. He first concluded CloudPanel had removed the renewal command from its CLI, then found the command still exists and is scoped to the clp user rather than root, so the cron had been calling it correctly all along. The underlying cause was never established, because that cron discarded its own output. Covers ruling out the HTTP-01 challenge by hand, the independent expiry monitor that caught it, and the reissue script and watchdog he built afterwards.
- [My Journey: From Jakarta to UW](https://joechamdani.com/blog/my-journey): Background and path into tech, from Jakarta to UW.
- [BC Hacks 2024](https://joechamdani.com/blog/bc-hacks-2024): Organizing a college hackathon.

Written by Joseph, published elsewhere:

- [Designing an AI System for Transfer Credit Evaluation](https://medium.com/@joseph.chamdani/designing-an-ai-system-for-transfer-credit-evaluation-3a6d5c48d63e): System design writeup of the hackathon-winning transfer credit tool. Canonical home is Medium.

Coverage of Joseph's work, written by others:

- [IShowStream: AI That Reads Twitch Chat](https://medium.com/@jessica.fiona2004/ishowstream-ai-that-reads-twitch-chat-so-streamers-dont-miss-a-moment-112342be7e32): Feature about the team's five-agent Twitch chat system, written by Joseph's teammate Juwita Jessica Pangestu, not by Joseph.
